title: South Beach Panoramic Night Segway Tour
includes: Use of Segway, helmet and bluetooth aer piece
Segway training session before the tour begins
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 2 persons per booking is required.
Participants must weigh at least 100 lbs. (45 kg) and no more than 260 lbs. (117 kg). They also need to be in good health.
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately.
We require a hold of a refundable Security Deposit on your credit card of $250 per booking (not per person) at the shop, before the tour stats.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
After dark, South Beach turns luminous: neon on Ocean Drive, soft light on the pastel hotels, cooler Atlantic air. This South Beach night Segway tour is a guided glide through that evening cityscape on the streets.

Meet at 233 14th Street, one block west of Ocean Drive between Washington Avenue and Collins Avenue. After a short training, your guide leads you through the Art Deco District and along Ocean Drive as the lights come on. Segway, helmet, cold water, and a live guide are included. First time riders are welcome on this panoramic night Segway. Segways stay on the streets. You can see Biscayne Bay from the route. There is no beach or Beachwalk access on Segway.

Book your Miami Beach night Segway tour.
